title: Executive dashboard loads composite security score, financial exposure, and top risks together
description: ExecutiveDashboardService computes the Security Score as a weighted composite (technical 35%, process 25%, governance 20%, people 20%, renormalized over whatever sub-scores are actually available) — verifies the full page assembles all KPI cards from one /executive-dashboard call within the default 90d timeframe.
preconditions: Logged in as a user with vciso.read permission
Org has at least one completed FAIR scenario and one activated compliance framework
steps: Log in and navigate to /vciso/executive-dashboard
Observe the Security Score card, Financial Exposure card, Compliance Summary widget, and Top Risks table
Confirm all widgets reflect the same default 90d timeframe
expectedResult: Dashboard renders all KPI widgets from a single load; Security Score is an integer 0-100 reflecting the weighted composite of available sub-scores; Financial Exposure and Top Risks are consistent with the same timeframe and organization.

title: Initiative creation, milestone tracking, and atomic budget expense recording flow end to end
description: Verifies the roadmap -> initiative -> milestone -> expense chain in StrategicPlanningService, including the $inc-based atomic expense recording (POST /initiatives/:id/expenses) that avoids read-modify-write races on budget.spent.
preconditions: Logged in as a user with vciso.create and vciso.update permissions
steps: Create a security initiative with budget.allocated=50000 and a valid timeline (targetDate after startDate)
Add a milestone to the initiative with a target date
Record two budget expenses of 1000 and 1500 via the 'Log Expense' action
Reload the initiative detail view
expectedResult: Initiative appears on the roadmap with owner and category; milestone shows status 'pending'; budget.spent equals exactly 2500 (both expenses applied atomically, no lost update) and remaining budget is recalculated correctly.

title: FAIR scenario creation, Monte Carlo simulation run, and stored results retrieval
description: Covers the full FAIR quantification path: createScenario -> runSimulation (10000-iteration Monte Carlo over PERT-sampled loss event frequency/magnitude) -> getSimulationResults returning the same stored statistics later.
preconditions: Logged in as a user with vciso.create permission
steps: Navigate to /vciso/risk-intelligence and create a new FAIR scenario with loss event frequency and primary/secondary loss magnitude ranges (min/likely/max)
Run the Monte Carlo simulation (default 10000 iterations)
Note the reported ALE statistics and distribution
Navigate away and reopen the scenario's stored results
expectedResult: Simulation returns iterations, statistics (mean/percentiles), lef, lossMagnitude, and a distribution array; reopening the scenario later via GET /scenarios/:id/results shows the identical stored statistics from the original run, not a fresh recompute.

title: Compliance Oversight page shows framework status, gap counts, and upcoming audit deadlines together
description: buildSmartCompliance counts every returned framework as 'active' (even one at 0% compliance) rather than filtering by complianceRate > 0 — this was a prior defect where the Compliance Oversight page under-counted frameworks vs. the Reports page.
preconditions: Org has 2 activated frameworks, one with 0% current compliance
An external audit is scheduled 10 days from today
steps: Navigate to /vciso/compliance-oversight
Observe the Smart Compliance section's 'Active Frameworks' count
Observe the framework list and the Upcoming Audits section
expectedResult: Active Frameworks shows 2 (both frameworks counted, including the 0%-compliant one); gaps equals the non-compliant control count; Upcoming Audits shows the scheduled audit with daysToNextAudit approximately 10; each framework row shows name and rounded compliance percentage.

title: Third-Party Risk page aggregates vendor risk distribution, highlights critical vendors, and flags overdue reviews
description: Verifies the server-side ported version of the vendor-service normalization (buildRiskDistribution/buildHighRiskVendors/buildUpcomingReviews) that replaced the old client-side 3-tier fallback chain.
preconditions: Org has vendors across all 4 risk tiers (critical/high/medium/low)
At least one vendor's next review date is overdue
steps: Navigate to /vciso/third-party-risk
Observe the Risk Distribution chart and Critical Vendors highlighting
Observe the Upcoming/Overdue Reviews section
expectedResult: Risk Distribution bucket counts match the seeded vendor tiers exactly; vendors in the 'critical' tier are visually highlighted with riskScore and openIssues populated; the overdue vendor appears in the reviews list with its actual nextReviewDate.

title: Board report progresses from generation through approval, delivery, and PDF download with a frozen data snapshot
description: Verifies the report keeps a dataSnapshot/metricsSnapshot captured at generate-time (used by the versions/compare endpoint) so the delivered PDF reflects the data as of generation, not whatever changed in the org afterward — the report's 'freshness stamp'.
preconditions: Logged in as a user with vciso.create and vciso.approve permissions
At least one report template exists
steps: Create a new report from a template (POST /reports)
Trigger full content + PDF generation (POST /reports/:id/generate)
Change an underlying metric in the org (e.g. approve a new evidence item) after generation
Approve the report, then deliver it to recipients
Download the report PDF
expectedResult: Report transitions draft -> submitted/under_review -> closed -> delivered; the downloaded PDF's figures match the data snapshot at generation time, not the metric changed afterward; download returns actual PDF bytes with Content-Type application/pdf and a sanitized filename.

title: AI Strategy Advisor conversation returns tenant-scoped recommendations with no cross-tenant leakage
description: Verifies advisor-chat.routes.ts forwards org_context.organization_id from the caller's own JWT (never client-supplied) to python-ai, and that returned recommendations/citations only reference this org's own GRC data.
preconditions: Logged in as a user with vciso.read permission
Org has its own initiatives, risks, and frameworks distinct from any other tenant
steps: Navigate to /vciso/ai-strategy-advisor
Click the 'Security Budget Allocation' quick action
Review the AI response's recommendations and any cited sources
expectedResult: A conversation and message are created and persisted; the AI response's recommendations/citations reference only this organization's own initiatives/risks/frameworks; no vendor, risk, or framework name belonging to another tenant appears anywhere in the response.
requirement: ISO 27001 Annex A.8.16 (Monitoring activities / AI-generated content)

title: User without vciso.read permission is blocked from every vCISO sub-module, not just the landing redirect
description: layout.jsx wraps the vCISO section in <PermissionGate permission="vciso.read">. Confirms the gate applies at the shared layout level so all 7 sub-pages are blocked identically, and that backend routes independently 403 regardless of what the UI renders.
preconditions: User's role has zero vciso.* permissions
steps: Log in as the restricted user
Navigate directly to /vciso (should redirect to /vciso/executive-dashboard)

Navigate directly to each of the 6 remaining sub-module URLs: /vciso/strategic-planning, /vciso/risk-intelligence, /vciso/compliance-oversight, /vciso/third-party-risk, /vciso/board-reporting, /vciso/ai-strategy-advisor
In parallel, call the corresponding backend GET endpoints directly with this user's token
expectedResult: Every sub-page renders the standard access-denied state instead of any dashboard content; every backend endpoint gated on vciso.read (or a stricter vciso.* action) returns 403, independent of the frontend gate.

title: All 7 vCISO sub-modules render a designed empty state on a freshly onboarded tenant with zero data
description: Verifies getDefaultSecurityScore()/getDefaultFinancialExposure() and equivalent null-safe builders (buildSmartCompliance(null), buildThirdPartyRiskSummary(null,null,null)) actually reach the frontend as zeroed widgets instead of the page crashing on empty arrays or null vendor-service responses.
preconditions: Brand-new organization: zero initiatives, zero FAIR scenarios, zero board reports, no frameworks activated, no vendors onboarded
steps: Log in as the new org's admin
Visit each of the 7 vCISO sub-module pages in turn
expectedResult: Executive Dashboard shows default zeroed KPI cards (no NaN/crash); Strategic Planning shows a 'no initiatives yet' prompt; Risk Intelligence shows zero scenarios with a create-scenario CTA; Compliance Oversight shows zero active frameworks and zero gaps; Third-Party Risk shows a zeroed summary (not an error from a null vendor-service payload); Board Reporting shows only system templates with 0 generated reports; AI Strategy Advisor loads with its quick actions and no prior conversation history.
